narrative.overview: MyCCS translates the official College of Information Technology and Computer Science (CCS — IT, CS, and LIS) crest—Deep Crest Navy, Circuit Royal Blue, Shield Cyan, and Laurel Gold—into a crisp, high-contrast academic utility built for sunlit hallways and zero-connectivity auditorium doors. Primary actions use authoritative full-pill Deep Crest Navy (#0B2E59) shifting to Circuit Royal Blue (#0052CC), while hero moments (onboarding crest deck and GMetrix key-ready alerts) layer Shield Cyan (#0EA5E9) and Laurel Gold (#D4A500) peek cards behind a saturated blue deck.
keyCharacteristics: Official CCS crest color grammar: Deep Crest Navy (#0B2E59), Circuit Royal Blue (#0052CC), Shield Cyan (#0EA5E9), and Laurel Gold (#D4A500).
Full-pill primary and secondary buttons (999px) paired with editorial underline category tabs and stacked color-block hero decks (20px).
ISO-strict semantic status hues where Present (#067647), Late/Pending (#856404 on #FEF9E2), and Absent/Rejected (#B42318) each own one unshared hue + text label.
Identical 64px bottom tab registration across all post-auth Student and Org Officer screens.
Monospace typography reserved strictly for verifiable data: 6-digit OTPs, opaque signed QR tokens, masked GMetrix keys, and server clock offsets.

rules.name: The 60:30:10 Proportion Rule
rules.body: Every screen allocates 60% to dominant neutral ground (#F6F9FD/#FFFFFF in light mode; #0B2545 in dark scanner), 30% to Deep Crest Navy (#0B2E59) structure, wells, rules, and slate typography, and <=10% to Circuit Royal Blue (#0052CC), Shield Cyan (#0EA5E9), Laurel Gold (#D4A500/#856404), and semantic status accents.

rules.name: The Laurel Gold Contrast Rule
rules.body: Bright Laurel Gold (#D4A500) is reserved for graphic accents, peek decks, dark-background highlights, and icon badges with dark #0B192C ink—never as body text on white. On light surfaces, use Laurel Gold Ink (#856404) over #FEF9E2.

rules.name: The Unshared Status Rule
rules.body: Present Emerald (#067647), Laurel Gold Ink (#856404), and Absent Crimson (#B42318) always pair with explicit text labels (Present, Late, Absent, Pending, Approved, Rejected).

rules.name: The Self-Hosted Fonts Rule (GDPR & RA 10173)
rules.body: Never load fonts from Google Fonts CDN or any third-party font CDN. Bundle Public Sans and JetBrains Mono locally inside the application (expo-font / local assets in Expo mobile; self-hosted .woff2 or @fontsource/* in web-admin) so zero user IP addresses leak to external servers and offline rendering is guaranteed.

rules.name: The Honest Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace is used strictly for code, tokens, OTP digits, keys, and measurements—never as decorative heading styling.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Standard lists, forms, announcements, and metric sheets carry zero drop shadow and zero nested cards—separate rows with 1px solid #DCE5F2 horizontal rules inside one container.

dos: Do enforce the 60:30:10 visual budget on every screen (60% #F6F9FD/#FFFFFF ground, 30% #0B2E59/slate structure, <=10% #0052CC/#0EA5E9/#D4A500 accents).
Do pair Laurel Gold (#D4A500) graphic accents with dark #0B192C foregrounds and use #856404 on #FEF9E2 for text badges.
Do maintain >=4.5:1 contrast across all daylight (#F6F9FD/#FFFFFF) and dark auditorium (#0B2545) surfaces.
Do use flat 1px rules (#DCE5F2) inside single white sheets instead of nested cards.
Do self-host and bundle Public Sans and JetBrains Mono locally in the app (expo-font / @fontsource/* / local .woff2) for GDPR and RA 10173 compliance and offline reliability.
Do reserve JetBrains Mono strictly for verifiable data and tabular-nums for live counts.
donts: Don't flood full screens or multiple stacked sections with saturated #0052CC, #0EA5E9, or #D4A500 fills—keep accents within the 10% budget.
Don't set light yellow/gold text directly on white backgrounds.
Don't load fonts from Google Fonts CDN or any external third-party CDN (violates GDPR IP-disclosure rules and breaks offline venues).
Don't place marketing eyebrows above headings or add zero-offset glowing shadows on dark scanner elements.
Don't use Unicode emoji as UI icons—use 1.8px-stroke inline SVGs.
Don't expose raw PII in QR codes or raw GMetrix keys in push alerts.
